item.title: Football: Monaco's slide continues ahead of Real Madrid tie - Monaco Life
item.description: AS Monaco conceded their seventh defeat in eight Ligue 1 matches at the hands of promoted Lorient (1-3) as the Principality club were further distanced in the race for Europe. Friday night’s game at a sparsely populated Stade Louis II officially marked the second half of the Ligue 1 season. “The first half of the season leaves us a big margin to do better in the second,” said Sébastien Pocognoli pre-match.
